question: The average of 6 consecutive odd numbers is 16. What is the smallest of them?
solution: Consecutive odd numbers are evenly spaced, so the average is the middle value. The smallest is 5 below it: 16 − 5 = 11.

question: The average of 5 numbers is 17. If each number is increased by 10, what is the new average?
solution: Doing the same to every number does it to the average too: 17 + 10 = 27.
questionHi: 5 संख्याओं का औसत 17 है। यदि प्रत्येक संख्या में 10 जोड़ दिया जाए, तो नया औसत क्या होगा?
solutionHi: हर संख्या के साथ एक ही क्रिया करने से औसत के साथ भी वही होती है: 17 + 10 = 27।

question: What is the average of the first 63 natural numbers?
solution: They are evenly spaced, so the average = (first + last) ÷ 2 = (1 + 63) ÷ 2 = 32.

question: A shopkeeper buys 2 shirts at ₹1,000 each and 3 books at ₹600 each. What is the average cost of one article?

question: The average age of a father and his son is 37 years. The father is 36 years older than the son. How old is the son?
solution: Together they are 2 × 37 = 74 years. Taking away the 36-year gap leaves twice the son's age: (74 − 36) ÷ 2 = 19 years.

question: The total age of the 8 members of a family is 240 years. What will be their average age after 3 years?
